name: Plus/Minus Zero
source:
Play as Clover, a starry-eyed research android living an ordinary life as a college student. Record new experiences, revel in mundanity, and be a strange machine and a strange person.

This is a simple story about a robot. Her record is perfect, and she loves a world that finds her strange. This story ends one way. Please enjoy the journey to its fullest.

[From [url=https://violetfairy.itch.io/plusminus-zero]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演Clover，一个乐观的研究型机器人，过着平凡的大学生生活。记录新的经历，陶醉于平凡，做一个陌生的机器，一个陌生的人。

这是一个关于机器人的简单故事。她的记录是完美的，她热爱这个让她觉得陌生的世界。这个故事以一种方式结束。请尽情享受这段旅程。

[来自[url=https://violetfairy.itch.io/plusminus-zero]itch.io[/url]]
